title: Repeated Bash failures bypass progress limit
observed: Verification attempt details include a unique tool call ID; the progress guard hashes Details and treats identical Bash failures as different.
expected: The guard stops after the configured number of identical failed Bash calls even when metadata differs.

fix.note: Real CLI regression passed with progressLimit=2 and two unique Bash tool IDs.
